activity.notes: UNESCO and archaeological evidence associate Roi Mata with an early seventeenth-century chiefly domain in central Vanuatu. Because no defensible personal reign interval survives, ATLAS uses c.1600 as a representative approximate leadership point rather than inventing a multi-year reign.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chief Roi Mata's Domain
sources.citation_text: UNESCO identifies the property as three early seventeenth-century sites associated with the life and death of the last paramount chief Roi Mata of central Vanuatu.
